entities.summary: Michael Carruth is a southpaw Irish Olympic boxer from Dublin. He is best known for winning the welterweight gold medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. He turned professional in 1994 and retired in 2000. Michael Carruth was a athletes & competitors from Dublin (b. 1967-07-09, Dublin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
